description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 03.08.2015 to 09.08.2015
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It establishes new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This constitutes a regulatory matter and falls squarely within the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation."
